name: badge
title: Badge
description: One short fact about a thing: a kind, a version, a state or a count. A shallow stamp cut into the surface with the words in the engraved mono; a leading LED (steady, flickering once when the state changes) or glyph; a count that turns on the drum, 99+ past max; regular 18 and compact 15, matched to the type beside it. Badge.Anchor puts a count on another control's corner as a readout cap in the other colorway. Not pressable and not announced.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/badge.md. SwiftUI: MetalBadge in the MetalUI Swift package.
